skills.name: design-balance-and-proportion
skills.description: Analyze and improve symmetrical/asymmetrical visual weight, hero balance, image-to-text proportions, modular scales and responsive ratios without treating golden ratio as a requirement.

skills.name: design-brand-and-art-direction
skills.description: Build and review frontend brand aesthetic, moodboards, visual direction, imagery style, color and typography personality against documented audience, identity and design constraints.

skills.name: design-build
skills.description: Design and implement polished frontend layouts, visual systems, color palettes, typographic scales, whitespace, images, states and responsive components. Use while writing CSS/HTML/frontend code or refining existing UI aesthetics and art direction.

skills.name: design-color-theory
skills.description: Design and diagnose UI color palettes, color harmony, complementary and analogous schemes, neutral/brand accents, light and dark modes, semantic tokens and accessible actual color pairings.

skills.name: design-diagnose
skills.description: Classify visual aesthetic and composition problems in frontend screenshots, design systems, pages or components using Digital Polo design principles, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, Gestalt, spacing and brand direction. Use when a UI looks off, amateurish, cluttered, visually inconsistent or unpolished.

skills.name: design-hierarchy-and-emphasis
skills.description: Repair frontend visual hierarchy, weak or competing focal points, flat heading scale and misplaced action prominence with contrast, space, scale and clear reading order; review aesthetic emphasis without sacrificing accessibility.

skills.name: design-imagery-and-texture
skills.description: Improve web image and icon quality, scalable SVG/raster choices, photo crops, artwork consistency, textures and text-on-image legibility while respecting asset licenses and accessibility.

skills.name: design-layout-and-grid
skills.description: Repair visual composition, whitespace, alignment, grouping and responsive layout grids using Gestalt proximity, consistent spacing, CSS Grid and content-driven breakpoints.

skills.name: design-movement-and-flow
skills.description: Improve static visual scan paths and composition movement from headline through evidence to action; repair confusing layout sequencing without contradicting keyboard or screen-reader order.

skills.name: design-review
skills.description: Perform evidence-graded visual design reviews of pages, product UIs, screenshots, prototypes or CSS: evaluate layout, balance, hierarchy, typography, color harmony, whitespace, repetition, imagery and aesthetic consistency, then prioritize actionable repairs.

skills.name: design-rhythm-and-pattern
skills.description: Repair inconsistent visual repetition and pattern across UI cards, icons, spacing, backgrounds and pages while preserving salience and avoiding overwhelming decorative rhythm.

skills.name: design-typography
skills.description: Improve frontend typography with font pairing, serif versus sans, fluid type scales, line height, tracking, kerning, measure, localization, font licenses and readable heading/body hierarchy.

skills.name: design-unity-and-systems
skills.description: Unify aesthetic design across pages and components with reusable primitive, semantic and component design tokens, coherent brand style and appropriately scoped design systems.

skills.name: design-validate
skills.description: Verify frontend visual design changes for hierarchy, contrast, color roles, typography, responsive composition, brand unity, content overflow, visual regressions and user-intent preservation; distinguish objective checks from subjective visual judgment.

skills.name: security-api-files-and-realtime
skills.description: Assess and remediate api boundaries, file handling, graphql, websocket and webrtc risks in frontend and associated web services. Use for REST, GraphQL, upload, download, WebSocket, WebRTC, BOLA, file validation.

skills.name: security-authentication-and-sessions
skills.description: Assess and remediate authentication, sessions, identity tokens, mfa, federated sign-in and logout in frontend and associated web services. Use for login, session renewal or expiry, cookies, MFA, OAuth, OIDC, JWT, account recovery.

skills.name: security-authorization
skills.description: Assess and remediate authorization, object access, tenant isolation and server-enforced permissions in frontend and associated web services. Use for privilege escalation, IDOR, BOLA, cross-tenant access, role checks, record access.

skills.name: security-browser-and-origin
skills.description: Assess and remediate browser security, dom sinks, csp, cookies, origin separation and third-party scripts in frontend and associated web services. Use for CSP, CORS, CSRF, clickjacking, iframe, browser storage, third-party script, XSS DOM.

skills.name: security-build
skills.description: Implement secure web application, browser and API changes using OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 requirements and specialist remediation patterns. Use during frontend or connected service coding and targeted vulnerability fixes.

skills.name: security-configuration-and-secrets
skills.description: Assess and remediate secure application configuration, secret custody and operational exposure in frontend and associated web services. Use for secret leakage, debug configuration, env variables, deployment flags, headers, server settings.

skills.name: security-crypto-and-data
skills.description: Assess and remediate cryptography, transport security, data protection and privacy boundaries in frontend and associated web services. Use for encryption, TLS, PII, keys, hashing, secrets in storage, client data.

skills.name: security-dependencies-and-build
skills.description: Assess and remediate dependencies, supply chain, build provenance and secure coding workflow in frontend and associated web services. Use for dependency vulnerability, SCA, lockfile, CI, provenance, build, SBOM.

skills.name: security-diagnose
skills.description: Classify suspected web application security weaknesses by actual trust boundary, identify affected ASVS 5.0.0 requirements, and route to a focused security specialist. Use for ambiguous security reports and code review findings.

skills.name: security-injection-and-validation
skills.description: Assess and remediate injection prevention, contextual output handling, validation and untrusted content in frontend and associated web services. Use for XSS, SQL injection, template injection, unsafe HTML, untrusted URL, command input, SSRF.

skills.name: security-logging-and-failure
skills.description: Assess and remediate security event logging, audit signals and resilient error handling in frontend and associated web services. Use for security event, log injection, stack trace, audit, exception, incident, error leakage.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Audit frontend and associated API or service security against an explicit OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 level, with threat-boundary evidence, vulnerability triage and NIST SSDF practice alignment. Use for application security reviews and PR audits.

skills.name: security-threat-model-and-design
skills.description: Assess and remediate threat models, abuse cases, architecture and secure design reviews in frontend and associated web services. Use for threat model, trust boundary, abuse case, design review, security architecture.

skills.name: security-validate
skills.description: Verify OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 security assessment coverage, retest vulnerability fixes and reconcile code, scan and manual evidence. Use after security changes or when checking application audit completeness.

skills.name: ux-accessibility
skills.description: Diagnose and fix accessible UI issues: keyboard/focus, labels, screen readers, contrast, pointer targets, reflow, motion and WCAG compliance checks.

skills.name: ux-build
skills.description: Design, implement, or refactor frontend UI/UX flows, components, forms, dashboards, and interactions with evidence-based usability patterns. Use during actual UI creation or UX fixes, not only after a review.

skills.name: ux-controls-and-inputs
skills.description: Fix UI target-size, mis-tap, button placement, keyboard-control, interaction-state, and pointer affordance problems using Fitts’s Law and accessible control semantics.

skills.name: ux-decisions-and-load
skills.description: Fix overwhelming menus, cognitive overload, too many choices, poor chunking, hidden context, recall-heavy workflows, or misplaced complexity in UI design and implementation.

skills.name: ux-diagnose
skills.description: Classify observed UI/UX problems into actionable root-cause categories, identify relevant Laws of UX, and route to remediation. Use for vague usability complaints, confusing screens, screenshots, UX debugging, or when unsure which UX skill applies.

skills.name: ux-feedback-and-performance
skills.description: Fix slow-feeling UI, missing loading acknowledgement, stale or optimistic success messages, unclear progress, duplicate submissions, and async state feedback.

skills.name: ux-forms-and-errors
skills.description: Fix form usability, validation, ambiguous input, repeated entry, bad defaults, inline error messages, draft loss and recovery; design robust but secure user inputs.

skills.name: ux-journeys-and-motivation
skills.description: Improve multi-step journeys, near-end abandonment, interrupted tasks, emotionally stressful interactions, bad completion states and task flow while preserving user autonomy.

skills.name: ux-navigation-and-structure
skills.description: Fix confusing navigation, poor information architecture, unexpected labels, mental-model mismatch, redesign unfamiliarity, and difficult-to-find features in user interfaces.

skills.name: ux-onboarding-and-learning
skills.description: Fix forced product tours, poor novice discoverability, confusing first-run screens, progressive onboarding and contextual assistance without blocking users’ first tasks.

skills.name: ux-review
skills.description: Review or audit existing user interfaces, UX journeys, screenshots, prototypes, or code for usability issues; produce evidence-graded, prioritized findings linked to Laws of UX and testable remediation.

skills.name: ux-trust-and-ethics
skills.description: Review or repair deceptive UX, manipulative defaults, scarcity cues, trust breakdowns, unclear consent, hidden costs, persuasive design and aesthetic overconfidence.

skills.name: ux-validate
skills.description: Validate a designed or implemented UI/UX change with task-based usability checks, accessibility checks, keyboard/mobile flows, failure recovery, and explicit evidence. Use for verifying fixes and UI acceptance tests.

skills.name: ux-visual-hierarchy
skills.description: Fix weak visual hierarchy, misleading grouping, unclear affordances, excessive cards, competing emphasis, scannability failures, and icon ambiguity in UI.

skills.name: wcag-alternatives-and-media
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 image text alternatives, complex graphics, captions, audio description, prerecorded/live media and sign-language accessibility. Use when content cannot be perceived without vision or hearing.

skills.name: wcag-assistive-tech-and-status
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 accessible names, roles, values, control states and dynamic live status messages; interpret the updated 4.1.1 Parsing note. Use for ARIA, assistive technology and async UI defects.

skills.name: wcag-build
skills.description: Implement accessible UI and remediate WCAG 2.2 (default) or 2.1 criteria: forms, authentication, focus, pointer targets, gestures, media, semantic components, responsive behavior and assistive technology.

skills.name: wcag-diagnose
skills.description: Classify accessibility barriers against selected WCAG 2.2 or 2.1 criteria; route repairs by root cause, with WCAG 3.0 draft ideas strictly advisory. Use on unclear accessibility complaints, screenshots, keyboard and screen-reader defects.

skills.name: wcag-forms-and-error-prevention
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 input purpose/autocomplete, form labels, visible error text, correction suggestions, safe submission confirmation and help. Use for accessible form building and error recovery.

skills.name: wcag-keyboard-and-focus
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 keyboard parity, traps, focus order and visibility, single-character shortcuts, dialogs and custom widget keys. Use for keyboard-only failures and inaccessible focus behavior.

skills.name: wcag-language-and-predictability
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 language metadata, embedded foreign phrases, jargon and abbreviations, reading comprehension, consistent navigation and unexpected context changes. Use for language or predictability issues.

skills.name: wcag-navigation-and-discovery
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 bypass links, route/page titles, link purpose, multiple ways to find pages, heading labels and location cues. Use for accessibility navigation and orientation problems.

skills.name: wcag-pointer-and-touch
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 touch/gesture alternatives, pointer cancellation, voice-visible label matching, motion activation, target size and WCAG 2.2 AA minimums and concurrent inputs. Use for mobile and pointer access problems.

skills.name: wcag-review
skills.description: Audit page sets and workflows against selected WCAG 2.2 (default) or 2.1 A/AA/AAA requirements, with draft WCAG 3.0 research separate. Use for frontend accessibility reviews, PR audits and conformance gap analysis.

skills.name: wcag-semantics-and-reading-order
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 semantic HTML, headings, relationships, data tables, meaningful reading order and non-sensory instructions. Use for screen reader structure and DOM ordering defects.

skills.name: wcag-time-and-motion
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 time limits, session extension, timeout data preservation, autoplay, moving content, flashing safety and reduced-motion. Use for timers, unexpected interruptions and animation barriers.

skills.name: wcag-validate
skills.description: Validate WCAG 2.2 (default) or 2.1 audit evidence with automated, keyboard, touch, zoom and assistive technology checks; detect incorrect version/level mixes and report incomplete manual reviews.

skills.name: wcag-visual-and-responsive
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1/2.2 contrast, color-only meaning, 200% text resize, 320px reflow, text-spacing overrides, orientation and hover/focus popovers. Use for visual and responsive accessibility defects.
